name: mq-jms-testing
description: "Test WebSphere MQ/JMS flows and transaction semantics."
---
# Procedure

Inspect actual JNDI factories/destinations and message contracts. Specify test queues, correlation and reply behaviour, transaction ownership, redelivery/backout and duplicate processing. Use controlled fixtures; avoid uncontrolled consumers. Verify database/message consistency and clean up test messages.

# Contract

Read docs/STACK.md and the selected change inputs. Preserve source/requirement references. Persist outputs to changes/CHANGE-ID. Use templates where relevant. Do not modify controls or self-approve. Report blockers with the decision needed and affected artifacts.
